description_en: Provides passport recognition services for major countries and regions worldwide, including the United States, France, the United Kingdom, Japan, and South Korea. Supported fields include nationality, passport number, date of birth, name, and more
description_zh: 可对美国、法国、英国、日本、韩国等世界多个主要国家和地区护照提供识别服务，支持字段包括国籍、护照号码、出生日期、姓名等
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-passport --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1uHglUgHqK1RjSZFEXXcGMXXa-800-502.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizePassport

parameters.description_en:

* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
